halted.do_not: do NOT synthesize halt status from price gaps, missing opens or any proxy. An absent close currently classifies as UNEXPLAINED_HOLE and fails closed (INTEGRITY_STOP:OLS_WINDOW_INCOMPLETE). Reinterpreting such gaps as halts would convert an integrity refusal into an ordinary exclusion, which the frozen OWNER-C note in returns.py exists to prevent.
halted.evidence: assembly.classify() is the ONLY producer of stock_status in the bound path. Its docstring states: PRESENT / YOUNG / UNEXPLAINED_HOLE, keyed off the first present session. Mirrors the Phase 2B path exactly. HALT_WITH_EVIDENCE is not produced here because that path does not produce it; adding it would be a divergence, not an improvement. The implementation derives status purely from np.isfinite(closeadj).
halted.precondition_tested: prove the bound production inputs populate a calendar-aligned stock_status[t+1] carrying CellStatus.HALT_WITH_EVIDENCE
halted.timing_finding: the producer halt control covers the SIGNAL WINDOW [t-124, t] (classify_stock_window over stock_status[t-124 : t+1], which excludes index t+1), whereas ExecutionFacts.halted concerns the t+1 EXECUTION session. They are different controls over different sessions, so the producer control does NOT cover the enrichment fact. This is why halted is not UPSTREAM_CONTROLLED.
